text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, B, E, and D at gains felt rewarding, but a small profit alone is not a reason to sell; I should decide based on my plan and current prospects.","After the account fell for several periods, I learned not to hold just to avoid the pain of realizing a loss—or sell just because a loss feels alarming. I should make each decision deliberately.","The account later recovered somewhat without any trades, reminding me that recent price moves are not reliable forecasts. I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
